column2: #1647 / #1678 R2-F2 correction (append-only; `t1647-fixround-r1-findings` untouched). Its "audit table gains the endpoints" listed the 409 surface incompletely: `POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages` (idle -> resume_and_launch -> build_runtime -> _build_tooling) and `POST /api/sessions/{id}/recover` (RecoveryCoordinator._session_from_events) also surface SandboxHardeningError - injected registry failures answer 409 on both. The table now lists 11 endpoints and says the list is non-exhaustive, with a re-runnable check. `POST /api/projects/{id}/sessions` was probed and does not reach the registry (its 409 is WorkspaceMoveInvalid).
